0022600167.text: The Rockets, 6-1 through seven games and 2nd in the Southwest, host the 4-1 Celtics, who are on a four-game win streak and 4-0 at home, with Houston coming in on a win streak of its own and a 3-0 home record. Houston is without Fred VanVleet (knee), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their two games in 2025-26, and the last meeting was a 114-93 Rockets loss in Houston on February 4, 2026.
